premises.text: The car buying process has not significantly changed in the last 20 years.
premises.evidence_span: The way people buy and sell cars hasn't really changed much over the last 20 years.

premises.text: Finding a great deal on a car is difficult due to lack of centralized platforms and inconsistent information.
premises.evidence_span: Finding a great deal is hard because there's no centralized platform, inconsistent and illegitimate information, and no standardized pricing in the MENA region.

premises.text: Seas provides a transparent and AI-powered search engine for car buying.
premises.evidence_span: Seas condenses the entire search process into one transparent and AI-powered search engine.

premises.text: The AI can estimate car values and adjust pricing algorithms based on market conditions.
premises.evidence_span: The AI behind the pricing even scans the market to constantly adjust his algorithm to make sure that it stays relevant with the market as it is currently.

premises.text: The AI negotiation chatbot can contact dealers to negotiate prices on behalf of the customer.
premises.evidence_span: our AI negotiation chatbot, Seaser, automatically contacts every single dealer to ensure that he gets the best deal out there.

premises.text: Seas has achieved significant growth and user engagement since its launch.
premises.evidence_span: we currently grow 20% month over month. And 25% of all searches made inside the app converts into leads.

premises.text: The automotive market in MENA presents a significant opportunity for growth.
premises.evidence_span: To tackle the $9 billion automotive market ads, we have three channels of monetization.

premises.text: Leasing options for cars represent a growing market opportunity in MENA.
premises.evidence_span: About 60% of cars on the roads in the US and EU are leasing cars, whereas in MENA, it's only 1%.

value.text: Consumers can find the right car at the right time and price through a streamlined process.
value.evidence_span: CES has single-handedly wheeled together the highly fragmented auto-listing market so that when you're looking for a car, you can see both buying and leasing so you can get the right car at the right time at the right price.
